似然回答：假如某个假设为真，出现眼前这批数据的可能性有多大；后验概率回答：看到这批数据之后，这个假设本身有多可信。两者方向相反。

掷十次硬币出现七次正面，数据固定。似然是「固定数据、比较假设」：在正面概率 p=0.8 这个假设下算出七正三反的概率，是一个似然值；换成 p=0.5 又得到另一个值。似然越大，说明这个假设越能解释数据。

后验反过来问：看到七次正面之后，p=0.8 成立的概率是多少？由贝叶斯公式给出：后验 = 似然 × 先验 ÷ 数据出现的总概率。先验是看到数据之前你对各假设的相信程度。

两点提醒：不同假设的似然加起来不必等于 1，所以似然本身不是概率分布；有限数据只能让后验变大或变小，不能证实假设——七次正面只是让 p=0.8 比 p=0.5 更可信。

Population variance measures how spread out a whole set of numbers is around its average.

The average alone can hide spread: two classes both average 70, one with everyone between 68 and 72, the other with scores from 30 to 100. Variance is the number that tells them apart.

Compute it in three steps: find the average; take each value's distance from it; square each distance and average the squares. Squaring does two jobs — it stops positive and negative distances from cancelling (scores 5 above and 5 below would otherwise sum to zero and look like 'no spread'), and it makes large deviations dominate: a score 20 away counts four times as much as one 10 away.

The result is in squared units, which is awkward, so people often take the square root (the standard deviation) to return to the original units.

One limitation: variance measures spread around the mean only — one loose cluster and two tight clusters can share the same variance without the same shape.

正反馈是输出回过头来加强输入，让变化沿原方向越滚越大。麦克风对着音箱：声音进话筒，放大后从音箱播出，又被话筒收进去再放大，几圈下来就成了刺耳的啸叫——每次循环都把音量推高一级。复利是同一种回路：利息并入本金，下一轮按更大的本金生息。

它放大的是「变化的方向」，与好坏无关。癌细胞分裂出更多癌细胞、谣言被转发后获得更多转发，机制完全相同；而体温调节是负反馈——偏离就往回拉——所以身体稳定。评价好坏要看被放大的是什么：市场上赢家获得资源后吸引更多资源，效率上可以是好事，形成垄断又成了坏事。

放大也有条件：回路增益要超过损耗，且回路不能断。啸叫会停在设备的物理极限；等多数人感染后，传染病能接触的人变少，放大自动减弱。

Opportunity cost is the value of the best option you give up when choosing one option — not all the options you skipped, just the top one among them.

You have a free afternoon: nap, hike, or finish a project. You choose the hike. If finishing the project mattered most to you, that's your opportunity cost; the nap adds nothing, because you could never have done both anyway.

This is why a free afternoon isn't really free: no money changes hands, but you still pay by not doing the next-best thing.

Change one condition: if the project deadline disappears, its value drops, and the nap may become the real opportunity cost — the cost shifts with what you would actually do instead. So when something looks free, ask what you're giving up to get it.

检测出阳性不等于得了病。贝叶斯公式回答的是：阳性之后，真患病的概率有多大。

设患病率 1%（每 1000 人 10 个），灵敏度 99%（病人几乎都测出阳性），假阳性率 5%（健康人有 5% 被误报）。1000 人里：约 10 个病人测出约 9.9 个阳性；990 个健康人误报约 49.5 个阳性。阳性共约 59.4 人，其中真病人只有约 9.9 个，所以阳性后患病概率 ≈ 9.9 ÷ 59.4 ≈ 17%。

公式写出来就是：P(患病|阳性) = P(患病) × P(阳性|患病) ÷ P(阳性)——先验 1% 乘上似然 99%，再除以阳性总概率。

为什么这么低？病人太少，健康人的假阳性在人数上压倒了真阳性。改变条件：患病率升到 10% 时，同样的检测会让阳性后患病概率跳到约 69%——先验不同，同一个阳性含义完全不同。

A cache keeps a copy of data close by so you don't re-fetch it every time. A product page is read 10,000 times an hour but changes twice a day — read it from the database once, keep the copy in memory, serve future reads fast.

Invalidation is deciding when that copy is stale and must be dropped. If the price changes in the database but the cache still holds the old one, users see a wrong price.

Main strategies: a fixed time-to-live — simple, but the data can be wrong until expiry; invalidate-on-write — updating the price deletes the cached entry so the next read refetches — accurate, but you must catch every code path that writes the price.

It's called a hard problem because 'when is my copy wrong?' is fundamentally a timing question between two stores that briefly disagree. Every option trades freshness against speed; pick based on how stale users can tolerate.

相关只说明两件事一起变，因果才说明一件引起另一件。冰淇淋销量和溺水人数同涨同跌，但吃冰淇淋不会让人溺水——真正的原因是夏天：天热既让人多买冰淇淋，也让人多去游泳。这种同时推动两个变量的隐藏因素叫混杂因素，它制造出相关的假象。

一起变有三种可能：A 引起 B；B 引起 A——比如消防车出动多的时段火灾多，不是消防车引来火灾；或者 C 同时引起两者。

条件变化是检验手段：如果只是混杂，把夏天这个因素控制住——只在夏天内部比较各天的冰淇淋销量和溺水——相关就基本消失；如果是真因果，控制其他因素后联系依然存在。医学的随机对照试验正是把人随机分组，让混杂因素在两组间抵消，再看处理组与对照组有没有差别，所以它能确证因果。

因此看到「研究表明 X 与 Y 相关」，先问：有没有共同原因？谁先谁后？控制住混杂后联系还在吗？

Compound growth means the gain is computed on the accumulated total, not just the original amount — so gains start earning gains.

At 10% a year: 100 becomes 110, then 121, then 133. Each year's increase grows because the base it multiplies keeps growing. After n years: starting × 1.1^n. Simple growth instead adds a flat 10 each year and reaches 200 in ten years; compounding reaches 100 × 1.1^10 ≈ 259, and the gap widens every year.

The starting amount matters because the same factor multiplies it: 1,000 at 10% becomes about 2,594 in ten years, while 100 becomes only 259. Same rate, same waiting — ten times the outcome, because the exponent acts on whatever you begin with.

Two conditions: losses compound too (−50% needs +100% to recover), and time is what makes the exponent bite — most of the total comes from the final years, which is why starting early outweighs starting big.

过拟合是模型把训练数据背得太死，连噪音也当成规律，换新数据就不灵了。

类比考试：一个学生不学方法，把题库每道题的答案都背下来。模拟卷（就是那本题库）他考满分，因为每题都见过；换张新卷子就崩——他记住的是具体答案，不是解法。模型也一样：看一万张猫狗照片，它可能把「这张猫照片左上角有水印」当成猫的特征，而不是学会胡须、尖耳朵这些真正的规律。

怎么辨认？训练时准确率很高，在没见过的数据上明显下降——这个落差就是过拟合的信号。

条件变化：数据越多、模型越简单，越难把噪音当规律。所以对策是加数据、限制模型复杂度，或留出一部分数据不参加训练，专门检验它学的是方法还是背的答案。

Say a search returns 10 results: 6 genuinely relevant, 4 junk. The catalog actually contains 40 relevant items in total.

Precision asks: of what was returned, how much was good? 6/10 = 60%. Low precision means wading through junk. Recall asks: of all the good material, how much was found? 6/40 = 15%. Low recall means missing most of what exists.

They pull in opposite directions. Return only the one certain hit: precision 100%, recall 2.5%. Return everything: recall 100%, precision sinks to the overall relevance rate. Improving one tends to cost the other, which is why both are reported rather than a single score.

Which matters more depends on the cost of each mistake. A lawyer hunting precedents can't afford to miss one — recall first. A casual web search drowns in junk if precision drops — precision first. Define the errors, then weigh them.

自然选择改变种群，靠的不是个体努力，而是「随机变异 + 差异存活繁殖」的筛选。

过程分三步。第一，个体间本来就有随机差异：同一种蛾子，有的体色深有的浅，谁也没打算变成哪种颜色。第二，环境筛选：工业区树皮被烟熏黑，浅色蛾子停在树上容易被鸟吃掉，深色的更容易活。第三，存活者繁殖，把体色传给下一代——活下来不算数，能留下后代才算。许多代之后，种群中深色个体的比例可能从 2% 升到 90%：变的是整个种群的概率构成，不是哪只蛾子改变了颜色。

要避开的误解：长颈鹿不是伸脖子够高处的叶子、用多了脖子就变长；而是脖子天生稍长的个体吃得更多、留下更多后代，代代之后「长脖子的基因」在种群中变多。个体无法为了种群主动进化，选择只作用于已有的随机差异，方向由环境决定——所以是「被筛选出来」，不是「练出来的」。

Idempotency means running the same operation multiple times has the same effect as running it once.

It matters in distributed systems because networks are unreliable: the server may process your request but lose the confirmation, forcing the client to retry — so the operation can actually execute twice. 'Charge card $50' run twice costs the customer $100; 'set order status to shipped' run twice changes nothing. The first is not idempotent; the second is.

You build idempotency in by design: attach a unique request ID so the server skips duplicates, or prefer assignments like 'set balance = 100' over 'balance += 50'.

The cost is extra bookkeeping — storing IDs and checking them atomically — and it only works when the same input has the same intended result. But wherever retries and timeouts exist, idempotency is what makes repeating a message safe instead of fearful.

信息熵衡量结果揭晓前你有多不确定：平均需要多少信息才能确定答案。

为什么均匀概率最不确定？一支球队十场赢九场，赛前你基本笃定；五五开时你毫无头绪——同样只揭晓一个结果，各结果难分主次时最难猜。熵把这种难度对所有结果取平均。

公式 H = −Σ p·log p：每种结果的概率乘上其概率的对数，求和后取负。对数让小概率事件的「意外程度」权重极高，取负把对数转正。均匀分布时熵最大：两种结果各半，H = 1 比特，问一次「是正面吗」即可确定；概率 0.99 对 0.01 时 H ≈ 0.08 比特——几乎不用问，偶尔为稀罕结果惊讶一次。

两点注意：熵只看概率分布，不看结果的实际含义；结果种类越多、分布越均匀，熵越大。

Deadlock is when processes each hold a resource and wait for one another's, so none can ever proceed.

Two processes, two locks. Process A locks the accounts file, then needs the log file. Process B locks the log file, then needs the accounts file. A waits for B, B waits for A, and neither releases what it holds because each is blocked mid-task. They wait forever — and anyone else needing those locks gets stuck too.

Four conditions must all hold: exclusive resources, holding while waiting, no forcible preemption, and a circular wait. Break any one and deadlock becomes impossible, which points to the standard fixes: acquire locks in the same global order everywhere (breaks the cycle), or grab all needed locks up front (breaks hold-and-wait).

Unlike a crash, a deadlock never announces itself — the system just slows down and waits. That silence is what makes it dangerous in practice.

公共物品有两个特征：不排他——没法阻止任何人使用；非竞争——多一个人用，不减少别人能用的量。路灯、国防、干净的空气都是：你无法只给付钱的人照明。

这带来一个麻烦——搭便车：既然不付钱也照样享受，理性的个人就倾向不掏钱，等别人出钱自己白享。

但人人这么算，公共物品就没人提供。楼道灯坏了，十户人家每户出 50 元能修好，每户觉得值 100 元。若都等别人先掏钱，灯就一直不亮：人人想省 50 元，结果各损失 100 元，个人的精明换来集体的糟糕结局。

这就是市场供给不足、要靠税收和强制缴费的原因——路灯和国防收不到「使用费」。

改变条件试试：一旦能排他，局面就反过来。有线电视对不付费者关掉信号，搭便车行不通，私人公司就愿意供给。

Little's law: L = λW. In a stable system, the average number of items inside (L) equals the arrival rate (λ) times the average time each spends inside (W).

A coffee shop takes 10 customers per minute (λ), and each spends 3 minutes ordering and waiting (W). Then on average L = 10 × 3 = 30 people are inside — counted without counting heads. Why multiply? Check the units: 10 people arriving each minute, each lingering 3 minutes, gives 30 person-minutes of 'people present' at a typical moment.

The law's power is that you can compute whichever quantity is hardest to measure. A server holding 200 requests while receiving 1,000 per second has an average latency of 0.2 seconds.

One condition: stability. Arrivals must not outrun capacity indefinitely; if the queue grows without bound, W climbs forever and no fixed relationship remains.
